$comment: Optional. Drop this at <project>/cem.config.json or point at it with --config / CEM_CONFIG.

packages.$comment: Allow-list and deny-list applied after discovery. Omit to discover everything.

paths.$comment: Manual package -> manifest path for CEMs outside node_modules (vendored builds, monorepo siblings). Paths resolve relative to this file.

adapters.$comment: Skip specific built-in adapters by name. Useful if a non-CEM file happens to match one and you'd rather not surface it.

synonyms.$comment: Extend the bidirectional UI-domain synonym map. Pairs declared in either direction become bidirectional. No transitive closure.
